title: Masala Fish Fry (AA Meats Style)
ingredients: 1.5 lbs white fish or salmon fillets (AA Meats masala-marinated or fresh), cut into portions
1 tsp ground coriander & 1 tsp roasted cumin powder
1/2 tsp turmeric powder & 1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp besan (gram flour) + 1 tbsp rice flour (for crispy masala crust)
2 tbsp mustard oil or avocado oil for pan-searing/air-frying
Fresh cilantro, chaat masala, and sliced red onions to serve
instructions: Combine ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, Kashmiri chili, coriander, cumin, turmeric, garam masala, ajwain, besan, rice flour, salt, and a splash of water into a thick masala paste.
Coat the fish pieces thoroughly in the masala marinade and rest for 20–30 minutes.
Heat oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat (or preheat air fryer to 400°F).
Pan-sear the masala fish for 4–5 minutes per side (or air-fry 10–12 minutes) until the spice crust is deeply charred and crisp. Sprinkle with chaat masala and lemon juice.
